title: feat(dekvar): deep-enter ties rho3 variance on B12
science: The band's one genuine mutation test. Exact: Q_delta-eps == Q_rho3 and t_delta-eps == t_rho3 sitewise on B_12, while 864 directed deep-enter hops are priced 3 by delta-eps and 1 by rho3 — a clause that is live on a counted set of edges and provably absent from every geodesic. `mutation-idle-arrival` really runs the second Dijkstra. I verified the identity still holds on B_30.
